text: This last point is certainly important because almost everyone has come to recognise that machines are not only an economic necessity, but that a greater deal of drudgery can be avoided by the installation of a power tool. As an elementary example, surely no one can pretend to enjoy ripping out parts from hardwood. Most men would unhesitatingly use a machine if it were available.
